0022600098.text: The Detroit Pistons (1-0, first in the Central and first in the East) are on the road for their second game of the season against the Miami Heat, who have yet to play a 2026-27 game. Detroit is 1-0 at home and has won its only game so far, but Taurean Prince is out for personal reasons after averaging 9.2 points and 23.5 minutes per game last season. The teams have not met yet this season, and Detroit lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 121-110 defeat in Miami on March 8, 2026.
